problems.reason: The page gives mutually exclusive taxonomic assignments for Hesperonychus (Microraptorinae, eudromaeosaurian, avialan, dromaeosaurid sister to microraptorines, and Dromaeosauridae) without indicating they are different hypotheses or estimates.

notes: - contradiction: "Longrich and Currie classified Hesperonychus as a member of the Microraptorinae, a group previously thought to be restricted to the Early Cretaceous of Asia." / "In 2012, Martyniuk classified Hesperonychus as a eudromaeosaurian." / "In 2019, Hartman and colleagues suggested Hesperonychus was an avialan close to modern birds, though they disagreed with the classification of microraptorines as avialans." / "In 2020, Hesperonychus was recovered as a dromaeosaurid that was a sister taxon to, but not a member of, the microraptorines." / "Hesperonychus belongs to the family Dromaeosauridae.": The page gives mutually exclusive taxonomic assignments for Hesperonychus (Microraptorinae, eudromaeosaurian, avialan, dromaeosaurid sister to microraptorines, and Dromaeosauridae) without indicating they are different hypotheses or estimates.
